lines.text: Step one: your list. On the Your list card, press Change.
A panel opens with the box Scan these stocks. Type in it to search.
Lists come in groups: Index stocks, Sectors, F and O, My watchlists, and Type my own symbols, each with its size.
Index stocks holds the members of an index, such as NIFTY 50 or NIFTY 500. Sectors holds lists such as Banking or IT.
Here, a list of five hundred stocks. For your own, pick Type my own symbols and separate them with commas.
A list holds up to five hundred stocks, and Run scans all of them, within your broker's limits. There is no fixed fifty.
Press Done.
If the latest list cannot be loaded, an amber note says so, and the built-in NIFTY 50 list is used.
The card shows the list's name and size.
During a run, a line shows the progress, for example 120 / 500 done. If your broker's limit slows it, it says Slowed by broker limit.
When it ends, the header shows how many matched.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Step two: the chart. On the Chart card, press Change.
Nine timeframes: 1, 3, 5, 15 or 30 minutes, 1 hour, Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
Daily, Weekly and Monthly work without a broker. 1 minute to 1 hour need your own broker.
Weekly and Monthly candles are built from daily candles.
Scans read closed candles only. A closed candle is final; the forming one can still change.
Only an alert can read the forming candle, and it is marked: earlier, but it can change.
Press Done.
The card shows the timeframe in words. Daily is a simple start.
Inside a condition, you can also read a candle further back, or one side on another timeframe. Episode three shows how.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
